question: What are the known side effects of Acetylsalicylic acid?
cypher: MATCH (d:Drug {name: 'Acetylsalicylic acid'})-[:HAS_SIDE_EFFECT]->(se:SideEffect) RETURN se.name ORDER BY se.name LIMIT 10

question: Which drugs have Nausea as a side effect?
cypher: MATCH (d:Drug)-[:HAS_SIDE_EFFECT]->(se:SideEffect {name: 'Nausea'}) RETURN d.name ORDER BY d.name LIMIT 10

question: What are the approved indications for Metformin?
cypher: MATCH (d:Drug {name: 'Metformin'})-[:HAS_INDICATION]->(ind:Indication) RETURN ind.name ORDER BY ind.name LIMIT 10

question: Do Acetylsalicylic acid and Metformin share any side effects?
cypher: MATCH (d1:Drug {name: 'Acetylsalicylic acid'})-[:HAS_SIDE_EFFECT]->(se:SideEffect)<-[:HAS_SIDE_EFFECT]-(d2:Drug {name: 'Metformin'}) RETURN se.name ORDER BY se.name LIMIT 10

question: How many side effects does Warfarin have?
What are the indications for drugs that also cause Anaemia as a side effect?
cypher: MATCH (d:Drug)-[:HAS_SIDE_EFFECT]->(se:SideEffect {name: 'Anaemia'}) MATCH (d)-[:HAS_INDICATION]->(ind:Indication) RETURN d.name, ind.name ORDER BY d.name LIMIT 10
